content.text: **Summary:** Read ticket T-5001 and inspected the ml-batch namespace. All 8 feature-backfill pods are Pending because cluster-autoscaler scale-ups on the batch-c6i-4xl nodegroup are failing with AWS `VcpuLimitExceeded` (current limit 256 vCPU in us-east-1a). Since this requires AWS-side quota or nodegroup changes that neither the ticket owner nor I can perform, I escalated the ticket to the cloud platform team with the evidence and suggested remediation (quota increase / additional AZs or instance types).
